title: Table
statementMd:
John Doe has an $*n* × *m*$ table. John Doe can paint points in some table cells, not more than one point in one table cell. John Doe wants to use such operations to make each square subtable of size $*n* × *n*$ have exactly $*k*$ points.

John Doe wondered, how many distinct ways to fill the table with points are there, provided that the condition must hold. As this number can be rather large, John Doe asks to find its remainder after dividing by $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.

You should assume that John always paints a point exactly in the center of some cell. Two ways to fill a table are considered distinct, if there exists a table cell, that has a point in one way and doesn't have it in the other.

## Input

A single line contains space-separated integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100; *n* ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{18}; 0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*^{2}$) — the number of rows of the table, the number of columns of the table and the number of points each square must contain.

Please, do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Output

In a single line print a single integer — the remainder from dividing the described number of ways by $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.

## Note

Let's consider the first test case:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b342608ba56983f9c9aee6bc9317865ca090a0c.png)

The gray area belongs to both

5 × 5

squares. So, if it has one point, then there shouldn't be points in any other place. If one of the white areas has a point, then the other one also must have a point. Thus, there are about

20

variants, where the point lies in the gray area and

25

variants, where each of the white areas contains a point. Overall there are

45

variants.
statementZhMd:
John Doe 有一个 $*n* × *m*$ 的表格。John Doe 可以在表格的某些单元格中画点，每个单元格中至多画一个点。John Doe 希望通过这样的操作，使每个大小为 $*n* × *n*$ 的正方形子表格中恰好有 $*k*$ 个点。

John Doe 想知道，在满足上述条件的情况下，共有多少种不同的方式可以在表格中填入点。由于这个数可能很大，请求出它除以 $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$ 所得的余数。

你可以假设 John 总是在某个单元格的正中心画点。如果存在某个表格单元格，在一种填法中有点而在另一种填法中没有点，则认为这两种填法不同。

## 输入格式

一行包含用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*m*$、$*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100; *n* ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{18}; 0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*^{2}$）——表格的行数、列数以及每个正方形子表格必须包含的点数。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 输出格式

一行输出一个整数——上述方案数除以 $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$ 所得的余数。

## 说明

考虑第一个测试用例：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b342608ba56983f9c9aee6bc9317865ca090a0c.png)

灰色区域同时属于两个

5 × 5

正方形。如果灰色区域中有一个点，那么其他任何位置都不能有点。如果两个白色区域中的一个有点，那么另一个也必须有点。因此，灰色区域中有点的方案约有

20

种，而两个白色区域中各有一个点的方案有

25

种。总共有

45

种方案。
